customMethods.script:
'''
	Given a dataset, with each row representing an entered check sheet
	Each loop:
		- we create the check event (addCheckEvent)
		- for each column, we call saveChkItemEvent
	'''
	
	chkShtId = 244
	chkShtColumns = {
		'Batch #': 2595,
		'Metal': 2596,
		'Glass': 2597,
		'Green PET': 2598,
		'Black': 2599,
		'Label': 2600,
		'Unmelts': 2601,
		'PVC': 2602,
		'Low Melts': 2603
	}
	assetIds = {
		'QC1': 2483,
		'QC2': 2484,
		'QC3': 2485,
		'QC4': 2486,
		'QC5': 2487
	}
	statusIds = {
		'True': 4,
		'False': 11
	}
	dataset = self.view.custom.dataset
	for row in dataset:
		chkShtEventInfo = {
			'chkShtId': chkShtId,
			'assetId': assetIds[row['Resource']],
			'shiftNameId': None,
			'comment': None,
			'itemId': None,
			'chkShtTriggerId': None,
			'chkShtStateId': statusIds[row['Status']],
			'scheduledDate': system.date.now()
		}
		chkShtEventId = system.kanoa.quality.event.addCheckEvent(chkShtEventInfo, 18)
		system.perspective.print(chkShtEventId)
		for column in row:
			if chkShtColumns.has_key(column):
				chkItemEventInfo = {
					'chkItemEventId': None,
					'chkShtEventId': chkShtEventId,
					'chkItemId': chkShtColumns[column],
					'measNumber': 1,
					'chkItemValue': row[column],
					'chkItemStateId': None,
				}
				system.kanoa.quality.event.saveChkItemEvent(chkItemEventInfo, 18)
	return
